integrity: All reported counts are checked by a complete word-tree dynamic program and by an independent square-block breadth-first enumeration in the included standalone verifier. Research-priority comparisons are best knowledge, not a guarantee of absence of unindexed prior results.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact enumeration through length 48, for binary words and exactly one through nine square factors; no claim to characterize longer nonminimal products or larger alphabets; published source already provides one length-48 witness and proves ten-square exclusion.
title: Sharp minimum lengths for overlap-free binary products of up to nine squares
